name: agent-security-skills
description: Defensive Agent Skills for teams that build and run AI agents: audit skills and plugins before install, audit agent configuration, threat-model agent systems, review MCP servers, detect attacks in agent traces, and respond to agent incidents.

plugins.name: agentsec-kit
plugins.description: Defensive security skills for AI coding agents: audit skills and plugins before install, harden Claude Code/Codex/Cursor configs, threat-model agent apps, review MCP servers, detect hijacked agents in their own telemetry, and respond to agent incidents. Read-only scripts with no network access.

plugins.name: agentsec-guard
plugins.description: Optional runtime guardrails (hooks): blocks download-and-execute, asks before credential access, before publish or force-push right after untrusted web/MCP content, and before the agent edits its own config; warns when installed plugins change. Local checks only, no network.
